messages:
Maya: Hey folks — quick heads up, we have a candidate for SWE-2 on Thurs 10:30 PT. Need panel confirmations and a couple rubric clarifications before the loop. Can people confirm availability?

Priya: I can do 10:30. Will join remote. Do we still want the role-specific system-design probe in round 2 or keep it coding-focused?

Samir: I can cover the infra/design question if we want it. If not, happy to swap into the coding slot. :thumbsup:

Elena: Quick rubric Q — on the "readability/maintainability" axis, is a 3 meant to be "works + clean" or "works + some edge cases missed but readable"? Want to be consistent across panels.

Maya: Good Q. Last hiring sync said: 3 = "works, clear intent, minor edge cases ok"; 4 = "works, idiomatic, edge cases handled". I'll paste rubric snippet.

Maya: ```
Readability/Maintainability:
1 - Hard to follow, poor naming, no comments
2 - Some intent but messy, multiple refactor opportunities
3 - Correct, clear intent, minor edge cases ok
4 - Clean, idiomatic, handles edge cases
5 - Exceptionally clear, testable, thoughtful abstractions
```

Priya: Perfect, thanks. Also — debrief form link? I forget the new short-form one.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Please complete the panel debrief form within 24h of the interview. Form: https://redwood.company/debrief-form (short link).

Samir: If anyone needs to swap slots: I can take the coding slot for 11:30 instead of the infra question at 10:30. @Maya pls confirm and I'll update calendar.

Maya: @Samir that works. @Priya @Elena can you both still cover the other rounds if I move you 1 slot later?

Elena: Yes, I can shift to the later slot.

Priya: Fine for me too.

Maya: Cool — calendar updated, will send updated candidate brief. One more note: when scoring, please add one bullet under "notes" with a clear pass/fail rationale (1-2 lines) for the hiring committee. Helps speed decisions.

Samir: Noted. I'll add a short pros/cons list.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here or DM. :rocket:
